items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Forms Alliance To Build A Power Flexible AI Data Center

The alliance has started building what it calls the first purpose-built power-flexible AI data center, designed to adjust consumption with grid needs. AEMA plans to publish shared frameworks for grid-responsive data centers with input from utilities, regulators, and large AI infrastructure users.
